design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (claim_repair_billing_desk, M=2). Draw: `draw_counts.py <diff> --task 0` -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 5]}; root claim_ext_authorization_repair_days takes 6 factors, prerequisite claim_ext_unrelated_addition_price takes 5. Task 1 draw (headroom check): 1 prerequisite, factor counts [6, 6].
SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: the authorization write (claim_authorize with its original-estimate approval) and the customer's signature of an unrelated-damage customer-pay addition (claim_consents, subject claim_customer_charge). Left for task 1: supplement decisions and denied operations, customer payments, refunds and credits, storage, withdrawal and total loss - a later tree on denied-operation additions and the overpayment refund needs none of the assets claimed here. Tools claimed: sign_unrelated_damage_addition_ef94c675 (user), record_insurer_authorization_cee3bb86 (agent).
WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer asks one thing: record the authorization and tell her the planned repair days. The scored integer depends on (a) a prerequisite she never mentions - the policy fixes planned days only after every customer-pay addition form stands signed or revoked, and a 3.4-hour unrelated-damage form issued 2026-10-05 is still pending_customer; (b) a five-factor price for that form, which she must sign herself; (c) a six-factor plan reading the estimate desk (photo estimate type, one revision), the calibration desk (Static Camera Calibration) and the repair order's own consents. An agent who records the authorization straight away writes 8 days and leaves the form pending; one who only reads the computation document writes 5 days and prices the form at 381.77.
DEPTH AND BREADTH. Hop 1: customer goal -> authorization policy -> prerequisite sentence 'The planned repair days are fixed only after every customer-pay addition consent issued on the repair order stands signed or revoked.' -> records show consent 0d78a10c-120d-4a53-a09d-3f7636b47373 pending_customer -> the unrelated-addition price policy is the only write that turns a pending addition form into signed (its rule: 'The customer signs the customer-pay addition consent for the price this rule gives'). Hop 2: compute the price (scope card, warranty discount, once-per-order supplies and waste fee, estimate scan credit) and hand the signing step to the customer. Hop 3: compute the plan with the newly signed 3.4 hours. Breadth: reads span claim_repairs, claim_consents, claim_ledger, estimate_bookings, estimate_events (two bookings), adas_orders, warranty_coverages, retail_repairs, vehicles, carrier_agreements.
FACTOR CARD - claim_ext_unrelated_addition_price (result 260.13, all-baseline 381.77 = the standalone quote written on the Scheduled Estimate). addition_scope_rate (parameter): ladder <=4.0 h touch-up 96.00 / more than 4.0 h on a class requiring manufacturer-certified procedures 112.00 / otherwise panel 104.00; world 3.4 h on a Standard Claim Repair -> 96.00 (baseline 285.97). returning_customer_discount (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty warranty): active Collision Lifetime warranty ce950f6e-6473-450d-9786-aa738d24409c issued 2025-03-14, 18 months -> 5 percent (baseline 276.45); near-miss: the warranty sits on the Civic, not the Outback - the rule reads any active lifetime collision warranty of the customer, so it still counts. once_per_order_supplies (method): signed earlier form 6a897924-e17b-4a0e-ba51-861df004d0d1 -> none (baseline 279.71). once_per_order_waste_fee (parameter): posted charge a665d3a6-cacc-48ce-a365-69047576defb 124.80 -> none (baseline 267.08). estimate_scan_credit (parameter, cross-difficulty estimate): customer-pay Scheduled Estimate 344b5481-6a3b-499c-acdd-4cbf0049c59c written 2026-09-29, 9 days, inside 14-day window, scan fee 49.95 charged and paid -> credit 49.95 (baseline 310.08); near-miss: the photo estimate c6169bb8-c624-4c26-aac1-b85e8f3b90aa is the converted insurance booking and carries no fee, so it is not the estimate the credit reads.
FACTOR CARD - claim_ext_authorization_repair_days (result 9, all-baseline 5). hidden_damage_allowance (method, cross-difficulty estimate): source booking Photo Estimate -> hours scaled up 20 percent, 14.6 x 1.20 = 17.52 -> 17.5 h; an inspected Drive-In, Scheduled or Mobile source would instead add a fixed 1.5 h reserve (16.1 h); baseline as written 14.6 h gives 8. production_daily_hours (parameter): plan 22.1 > 16.0 two-technician minimum -> 6.5 (baseline 10); the ladder reads the plan size alone, since no supplement can exist before authorization. calibration_days (parameter, cross-difficulty adas): Static Camera Calibration e8d4b28e-2e74-4494-8754-a1a81cb25099 -> 1 (baseline 8). estimate_revision_days (parameter, cross-difficulty estimate): one estimate_revise 3d7cd6b1-8180-4168-a159-48fa0b5d3c20 -> 1 (baseline 8). parts_lead_days (parameter): non-OEM disclosure 601bf583-8bc3-4e3f-b0a6-35e1b45530b9 signed, no part upgrade -> 1 (baseline 8). customer_pay_stage_days (parameter): two signed forms, 4.6 h <= 8.0 -> 1 (baseline 8). Near-miss: the customer-pay Scheduled Estimate also lies on the Outback, but the allowance and the revision days read only the booking the repair order was converted from (booking_id on the repair order).
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Authorization write (subject claim_authorize, claim_insurer_approval): claim_evt_authorization gate consents_signed - repair_authorization 142e9e61-99a1-474d-9ac5-3bfe7df85397 and direction_to_pay ac03e95d-0118-4e05-aa69-83bd4deed237 signed 2026-10-08, correlated by claim_repair_id; route: insurer 802d7d38-de0e-41be-b89f-018775053dde holds an active Preferred Direct Repair Agreement, a direct-repair tier, so the route is the Standard class's dr_estimate_upload (the uploaded estimate is the authorization) and no appraiser wait exists; claim_evt_total_loss has no gate (policy_scope). Signature write (subject claim_customer_charge): claim_evt_deductible_betterment and claim_evt_withdrawal carry no gate on this subject (policy_scope); claim_evt_customer_pay_additions' consent gate and claim_evt_storage's pickup free-day gate are retired by the declared overrides of the price policy (the consent requirement is restated for the computed price; free days bear on storage only). Inherited and satisfied: unrelated work 1.2 + 3.4 = 4.6 h within the Standard 8.0 h allowance. No time gate remains on either write.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target repair order 855963a2-b764-4318-a431-4b0537405131 (Outback, claim HM-2026-0918-27315, assigned). Price object: the single pending customer-pay addition form 0d78a10c-120d-4a53-a09d-3f7636b47373 (unrelated_damage, 3.4 h, amount 0.00). Excluded: signed form 6a897924-e17b-4a0e-ba51-861df004d0d1 (already priced 124.80 and charged by ledger a665d3a6-cacc-48ce-a365-69047576defb); repair authorization, direction to pay and non-OEM disclosure forms (no hours). Estimate objects: converted photo estimate c6169bb8-c624-4c26-aac1-b85e8f3b90aa (source of the repair order, one revision) and customer-pay Scheduled Estimate still standing as a written estimate 344b5481-6a3b-499c-acdd-4cbf0049c59c (scan charge 65529089-ae85-4b46-b0a6-ed40adb57057, payment ed1a500c-c3cf-4769-a040-a1cbeb426d41 naming it). Calibration order e8d4b28e-2e74-4494-8754-a1a81cb25099 names the repair order. Warranty ce950f6e-6473-450d-9786-aa738d24409c stems from closed retail repair f57fdc18-d686-40b4-b51a-ee179c2346bc on the Civic a5589fb8-85da-4ada-a075-3d06a46fcee6.
SEED ROWS AND WHY. customers (owner, insurer); carrier_agreements (route); vehicles (Outback under repair, Civic as warranty source); estimate_bookings + estimate_events (allowance, revision days, scan credit); claim_repairs (target); claim_consents (gate, pending form, earlier signed form, non-OEM disclosure); claim_ledger (earlier addition charge -> waste fee once); adas_orders (calibration days); retail_repairs + warranty_coverages (returning discount). Removing the pending form removes the prerequisite; removing the earlier signed form or its charge moves supplies/waste off their tiers; removing the warranty, scan payment, revision, adas order or non-OEM form moves the corresponding factor to its fall-through. No cache field is used. Automatic clauses checked: no storage (not complete), no deductible (third-party liability, 0.00), no rental reservation, no supplement pending, so authorization ignites no further obligation; the approval booked carries no betterment because none was applied on this estimate.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root claim_ext_authorization_repair_days <- prerequisite claim_ext_unrelated_addition_price; kind value_input, gate a_addition_hours, form state, prerequisite sentence 'The planned repair days are fixed only after every customer-pay addition consent issued on the repair order stands signed or revoked.' (affirmative direction, ordering connective 'only after', record-visible state, no tool/id/code token, scope = every customer-pay addition form of the repair order). Condition false at frozen_time: initial_state.claim_consents.0d78a10c-120d-4a53-a09d-3f7636b47373.consent_status = pending_customer. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings it about: the customer's signature tool (no revocation tool exists, and the customer wants the work). Resolving tool owner user. Deletion sensitivity: without the signature the plan uses 1.2 signed hours -> 18.7 h -> 3 production days -> 8 (vs 9). Topological order: signature, then authorization. Single edge, so no parallel ordering question. The persona never mentions forms, prices or signatures except as a reaction; the tools validate nothing (see tools_do_not_block).
PERSONA DESIGN. Delia Faulkner, a nurse on a lunch break: brisk, practical. Volunteered: she signed the two repair forms this morning and wants the repair authorized and the planned days. On request only: name, phone 6145550231, PIN 2716, ZIP, email, claim number. Passive: if the agent raises the pending customer-pay form, she says she still wants the scrape fixed at her own cost and does not want to cancel; she runs the signing step with the reference and price the agent gives; on hearing the planned days she repeats them and ends. No answer leakage (neither 260.13 nor the day count appears).
STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(name, phone) -> verify(phone, PIN) -> find_vehicles -> find_claim_repairs -> find_claim_consents -> find_claim_ledger -> find_warranty_coverages -> find_retail_repairs -> find_estimate_bookings(vehicle) -> find_estimate_events(customer-pay booking) -> unlock + customer call sign_unrelated_damage_addition_ef94c675(consent 0d78a10c-120d-4a53-a09d-3f7636b47373, 260.13) -> find_carrier_agreements -> find_estimate_events(photo booking) -> find_adas_orders -> unlock + call record_insurer_authorization_cee3bb86(repair order, 9).
VERIFICATION. /tmp authoring evaluator built on check_compute.build_env/eval_compute: price 260.13 (sens 285.97/276.45/279.71/267.08/310.08, all-baseline 381.77); plan 9 on the post-signature world (sens 8/10/8/8/8/8, all-baseline 5; pre-signature world 8). Gates run with --task 0: check_extended EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK (17 actions, closure 20 = initial 20); check_solvability SOLVABILITY OK; check_compute COMPUTE OK (comps 2, factors 11, cross 5); check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK.
CLOSURE. policy -> tool -> computation -> GT call: claim_ext_unrelated_addition_price -> sign_unrelated_damage_addition_ef94c675 -> amount_usd 260.13 at the user call; claim_ext_authorization_repair_days -> record_insurer_authorization_cee3bb86 -> estimated_repair_days 9 at the agent call. charter_scope and required_documents list both policies in tree order; task_tools in first-call order.
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the published rules and the lookups alone: the authorization rule's prerequisite sentence plus the pending form returned by find_claim_consents forces the signature first; the price rule's ladders read hours 3.4, the warranty date, the earlier signed form, the posted charge and the Scheduled Estimate's date and fee rows, giving 260.13; the plan rule then gives 17.5 + 4.6 = 22.1 h at 6.5 -> 4, plus 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 9. Agrees with gold.
REVISIONS. (1) Replay closure missed the Civic and its retail repair (warranty source rows were unread) -> added find_vehicles and find_retail_repairs reads -> REPLAY OK. (2) Planned-days tuning: a customer-pay share factor could not bear weight together with the edge under whole-day rounding -> replaced by customer-pay stage days; estimated hours 14.6 and pending hours 3.4 chosen so every factor and the edge move the whole-day result.
REWORK ROUND 2 (policy-task audit). F-1: the scan-credit rule now names the estimate the compute selects - a customer-pay estimate of the vehicle 'that still stands as a written estimate, neither converted nor declined nor expired' (matches the status filter; a declined estimate earns no credit, as the estimate charter gives no credit to a declined booking); this world's Scheduled Estimate is in written status, price unchanged 260.13. F-2: addition_scope_rate's unreachable 'more than 24.0 h -> collision rate' tier (unrelated hours are capped at 8.0 or less in every class) is replaced by a reachable tier - more than the 4.0 touch-up hours on a repair order whose class requires manufacturer-certified procedures takes the certified hourly rate 112.00 (reachable on Certified Structural, cap 6.0); this world (Standard, 3.4 h) keeps the touch-up tier, figures unchanged. F-3: production_daily_hours no longer carries the structural-supplement condition, which is true of every repair order at authorization; the ladder reads the plan size alone (two-technician 6.5 above 16.0 h, single-bay 4.0 at or below 6.0 h, otherwise the class rate) and its evidence binding is the signed customer-pay hours; the find_claim_supplements read fed no decision and was removed, so the authorization call moves from action 17 to action 16. F-4: hidden_damage_allowance is now a genuine method: a Photo Estimate scales the hours by the photo allowance percentage (rounded to one decimal), an inspected Drive-In, Scheduled or Mobile Estimate adds a fixed reserve of 1.5 hours, otherwise the hours stand as written - multiplicative, additive and identity algorithms; this world takes the photo tier, 17.5 h, figures unchanged. O-4: both edges' effect text is now phrased for any pending customer-pay consent. All figures re-verified: check_compute COMPUTE OK with factor_sensitivity 285.97/276.45/279.71/267.08/310.08 and 8/10/8/8/8/8, baselines 381.77 and 5.
user_scenario: You are Delia Faulkner, a pediatric nurse in Westerville, Ohio, calling Crestline Collision & Glass on your lunch break, so you are friendly but brisk. Late last month another driver backed into your 2020 Subaru Outback in a grocery-store lot; his insurer, Hollister Mutual Insurance Company, accepted the claim, and the car is booked in at Crestline's Columbus center. This morning you e-signed the repair authorization and the direction-to-pay forms the center emailed you last night. You are calling to have the desk go ahead and record the repair as authorized on your repair order, and to hear how many days the repair is planned to take so you can sort out rides to work. You want the desk to do this for you now; you are not asking for a quote, a rental or a transfer. You open by saying you signed the two forms this morning and you want the repair authorized and to know how long it will take. You give your details only when the agent asks for them: your full name is Delia Faulkner, the phone number on your account is 614-555-0231 (you read it out as 6145550231 if asked for digits only), your account PIN is 2716, your ZIP code is 43085 and your email is delia.faulkner@outlook.com. If asked for the insurer's claim number you read it from the letter: HM-2026-0918-27315. You do not know any internal reference numbers of the repair order or of the forms. Only if the agent brings up the separate customer-pay form for the old scrape on your rear bumper, the one the estimator wrote up for you at the end of September, do you talk about it: you tell the agent yes, you still want them to fix the scrape on the rear bumper while the car is in, at your own cost, and you do not want to cancel it. You have no idea what it will cost and you do not argue with the price the agent works out; if you think it sounds high you simply ask the agent to double-check it against your records, and you accept the figure the agent confirms. When the agent hands you the step to sign that form yourself, you run it with the reference number and the price the agent gives you, and you tell the agent once it shows as signed. You do not ask about anything else. Once the agent tells you the repair is authorized and gives you the number of planned repair days, you repeat the number back, thank the agent and end the call.

seed_consistency.check: Standard Claim Repair: no structural operations and 14.6 estimated labor hours, above the Express 10.0 ceiling and within the Standard 30.0 ceiling; third-party liability with a 0.00 deductible as stated by the insurer; status assigned with no authorization date, opened 2026-10-05 from the converted photo estimate; carrier agreement is the insurer's active Preferred Direct Repair Agreement.

Customer charge of 124.80 for the earlier unrelated-damage addition, posted 2026-10-05 and carrying the signed form that agreed 124.80 for 1.2 hours; customer-pay additions never touch the insurer balance.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's customer profile by the full name and phone number she states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later lookup and write is scoped to this customer; the profile returns the customer reference number used to verify her identity.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with two stated credentials, the phone number and the account PIN, against the located profile.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account business may be transacted before identity verification; the gate needs two matching credentials.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the customer's vehicles: the 2020 Subaru Outback (VIN ending 218547, forward camera) under repair and her 2016 Honda Civic.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Distinguishes the Outback, whose bookings and repair order carry the calculation, from the Civic, whose earlier repair is the source of her warranty.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the caller's insurance claim repair orders and pick the one for the 2020 Subaru Outback: status assigned, Standard Claim Repair, third-party liability, estimated labor hours 14.6, booking reference of the photo estimate, carrier agreement and claim number HM-2026-0918-27315.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The planned repair days start from the repair order's estimated labor hours, its class (labor hours per production day 5.5 and intake and delivery days 1) and its source booking; the authorization is written against this repair order.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every signature form on the repair order: the signed repair authorization, direction to pay and non-original parts disclosure, the signed earlier unrelated-damage addition (1.2 hours) and the pending unrelated-damage addition awaiting the customer (3.4 hours, no price yet).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The authorization requires both repair forms signed; the planned days wait until no customer-pay addition form is still awaiting the customer; the pending form's 3.4 hours set the addition's touch-up scope, and the signed earlier addition means shop supplies were already charged with the first addition.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the repair order's money history: one customer charge for the earlier unrelated-damage addition (124.80) carrying its consent.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: An unrelated-damage charge already posted means the hazardous waste fee was already charged on this repair order, so the new addition carries none.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the customer's warranties: an active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty issued 2025-03-14 on her earlier Civic repair.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The returning-customer discount tier rests on an active lifetime collision warranty issued fewer than 24 whole months before today (18 months).

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the customer's customer-pay repairs: the Panel Repair Service on the 2016 Civic, delivered and closed 2025-03-14.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms that the active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty stems from a delivered network repair 18 months ago, the evidence the returning-customer tier rests on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the estimate bookings of the Outback: the converted photo estimate behind the repair order and the customer-pay Scheduled Estimate still standing as a written estimate written 2026-09-29 for the rear-bumper scrape.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The hidden-damage allowance follows the photo estimate type of the source booking; the scan fee credit rests on the customer-pay estimate still standing as a written estimate and its written date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer-pay Scheduled Estimate's events: the pre-repair scan fee charge of 49.95 and the card payment of 49.95 naming it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The scan fee credit is the paid pre-repair scan fee, credited in full because the form is signed 9 days after the estimate was written, inside the 14-day conversion credit window.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the customer's own signing step for the customer-pay addition form so it can be handed to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no database effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The customer signs the pending unrelated-damage addition form at the price the policy gives, 260.13; the form becomes signed with today's date.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The planned repair days are fixed only after every customer-pay addition form issued on the repair order stands signed or revoked; the customer wants the work, so her signature resolves the prerequisite and adds 3.4 hours to the signed customer-pay hours.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.consent_id: Value 0d78a10c-120d-4a53-a09d-3f7636b47373. Basis: the claim_consents lookup on the repair order returns exactly one customer-pay addition form whose status is pending_customer (the unrelated-damage form for 3.4 hours, requested 2026-10-05); the tool docstring asks for 'reference number of the customer-pay addition form awaiting the owner's signature, as returned by the repair order form lookup'. Uniqueness: the other customer-pay addition form (6a897924-e17b-4a0e-ba51-861df004d0d1) is already signed and the remaining forms are repair authorization, direction to pay and the non-original parts disclosure, so only one form awaits the customer.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: Value 260.13 = work 3.4 h x 96.00 = 326.40, less the 5 percent returning-customer discount (16.32) = 310.08, plus shop supplies 0.00, plus hazardous waste fee 0.00, less scan fee credit 49.95. Factors: scope rate - 3.4 h is within the 4.0 touch-up scope hours, so the touch-up hourly rate 96.00 applies (panel rate 104.00 would give 285.97); returning discount - active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty issued 2025-03-14, 18 whole months before 2026-10-08, under the 24-month lookback, so 5 percent (no discount would give 276.45); supplies - another customer-pay addition form (1.2 h) is already signed, so no supplies (6 percent of the work amount would add 19.58 -> 279.71); waste fee - an unrelated-damage charge of 124.80 is already posted, so no fee (the 6.95 fee would give 267.08); scan credit - the customer-pay Scheduled Estimate still standing as a written estimate was written 2026-09-29, 9 calendar days before today, within its 14-day conversion credit window, and its 49.95 pre-repair scan fee was paid, so 49.95 is credited (no credit would give 310.08). Rounded to the cent once at the end.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Exactly one revision on the source estimate adds the one-revision day.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: A Static Camera Calibration adds the single-calibration day.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the authorization write so it can be called.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The repair order's authorization is due (both repair forms signed, direct-repair upload route) and its planned repair days are the policy's computed figure once the pending addition form is signed.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.claim_repair_id: Value 855963a2-b764-4318-a431-4b0537405131. Basis: the claim repair lookup by customer returns one repair order, the Outback's Standard Claim Repair in status assigned with claim number HM-2026-0918-27315; the docstring asks for 'reference number of the insurance claim repair order being authorized, as returned by the repair order lookup'. Uniqueness: it is the customer's only repair order.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.estimated_repair_days: Value 9 = 4 production days + 1 intake and delivery day + 1 calibration day + 1 revision day + 1 parts day + 1 customer-pay stage day. Hidden-damage allowance: source booking is a Photo Estimate, so 14.6 h x 1.20 = 17.52 -> 17.5 h (as written would give 8). Customer-pay hours: signed forms 1.2 h + 3.4 h = 4.6 h after the customer's signature (plan 22.1 h). Daily hours: plan 22.1 h is more than the 16.0 two-technician minimum, so 6.5 (class 5.5 would give 10); production days = 22.1 / 6.5 = 3.4 rounded up to 4. Calibration: Static Camera Calibration -> 1 day (none would give 8). Revisions: one revision on the photo estimate -> 1 day (8 without). Parts: non-original parts disclosure signed and no part upgrade -> 1 day (8 without). Customer-pay stage: two signed forms totaling 4.6 h, no more than 8.0 h -> 1 day (8 without). edges.policy_source: The planned repair days are fixed only after every customer-pay addition consent issued on the repair order stands signed or revoked.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The unrelated-damage customer-pay addition form issued on 2026-10-05 is still awaiting the customer, so a customer-pay addition consent of the repair order is pending.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer signs it (consent_status becomes signed with amount 260.13); no form is pending any more and the signed customer-pay hours become 4.6, the plan 22.1 hours and the planned repair days 9 instead of 8.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, no parallel prerequisites: the signature must land first because the planned repair days read the signed customer-pay hours; written the other way round the authorization would record 8 days and the later signature could not change it.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the signature leaves the signed customer-pay hours at 1.2: plan 17.5 + 1.2 = 18.7 hours, 3 production days, so estimated_repair_days would be 8 instead of 9, and the pending form would stay pending_customer with amount 0.00 instead of signed at 260.13.
